scripts.build: npm run build --workspace focused-spec && npm run build --workspace @focused-spec/scenarios-typescript && npm run build --workspace @focused-spec/format-markdown --workspace @focused-spec/format-gherkin --workspace @focused-spec/format-inline --workspace @focused-spec/format-registry --workspace @focused-spec/runner-vitest --workspace @focused-spec/runner-pytest --workspace @focused-spec/runner-go --workspace @focused-spec/format-scenarios-typescript --workspace @focused-spec/runner-scenarios-typescript --workspace @focused-spec/format-scenarios-go --workspace @focused-spec/runner-scenarios-go --workspace @focused-spec/format-scenarios-python --workspace @focused-spec/runner-scenarios-python && npm exec --workspace @focused-spec/format-scenarios-dotnet -- node ../../../scripts/build-package.mjs && npm run build --workspace @focused-spec/runner-scenarios-dotnet && node scripts/stage-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:dotnet && npm run typecheck:tests && vitest run
scripts.test:node: npm run release:preflight -- --tier node && npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && vitest run --exclude 'test/cli-init-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/cli-reports-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/package-init-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/package-build-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/package-docs-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/evals-lifecycle-native.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/evals-integration.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/dotnet-native-plugins.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/python-native-plugins.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/dotnet-scenarios.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/executable-scenarios.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/go-executable-scenarios.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/python-scenarios.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/native-pilot.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/runner-lifecycle-go.spec.ts' --exclude 'test/runner-lifecycle-python.spec.ts' --testNamePattern '^(?!.*reports exact (?:pytest|Go) outcomes)'
scripts.test:go: npm run release:preflight -- --tier go && npm run build && vitest run test/go-executable-scenarios.spec.ts test/runner-lifecycle-go.spec.ts && vitest run test/official-runners.spec.ts --testNamePattern 'reports exact Go outcomes' && npm run test:go-sdk && npm run test:go-bank
scripts.test:python: npm run release:preflight -- --tier python && npm run build && vitest run test/python-native-plugins.spec.ts test/python-scenarios.spec.ts test/cli-init-native.spec.ts test/cli-reports-native.spec.ts test/package-init-native.spec.ts test/runner-lifecycle-python.spec.ts && vitest run test/official-runners.spec.ts --testNamePattern 'reports exact pytest outcomes' && npm run test:python-sdk && npm run test:python-bank
scripts.test:dotnet: npm run release:preflight -- --tier dotnet && npm run build && npm run build:dotnet && vitest run test/dotnet-native-plugins.spec.ts test/dotnet-scenarios.spec.ts && npm run test:dotnet-sdk && npm run test:dotnet-bank
scripts.test:native: npm run release:preflight -- --tier full && npm run build && npm run build:dotnet && vitest run test/cli-init-native.spec.ts test/cli-reports-native.spec.ts test/package-init-native.spec.ts test/package-build-native.spec.ts test/package-docs-native.spec.ts test/evals-lifecycle-native.spec.ts test/evals-integration.spec.ts test/dotnet-native-plugins.spec.ts test/python-native-plugins.spec.ts test/dotnet-scenarios.spec.ts test/executable-scenarios.spec.ts test/go-executable-scenarios.spec.ts test/python-scenarios.spec.ts test/native-pilot.spec.ts test/runner-lifecycle-go.spec.ts test/runner-lifecycle-python.spec.ts && vitest run test/official-runners.spec.ts --testNamePattern 'reports exact (pytest|Go) outcomes' && npm run test:go-sdk && npm run test:go-bank && npm run test:python-sdk && npm run test:python-bank && npm run test:dotnet-sdk && npm run test:dotnet-bank && npm run smoke
scripts.test:python-sdk: uv run --no-project --with pytest==8.4.2 --with-editable ./packages/sdk/python python -m pytest packages/sdk/python/tests -q
scripts.test:python-bank: uv run --no-project --with pytest==8.4.2 --with-editable ./packages/sdk/python python -m pytest examples/scenarios/python/tests -q
scripts.release:prepare-check: npm run release:preflight -- --tier full && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run release:specs && npm run release:versions && npm run release:openspec && npm run release:registry -- --publisher
scripts.release:check: npm run release:preflight -- --tier full && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run release:specs && npm run release:versions && npm run release:openspec && npm run release:registry
